note: Set B is more accurate on critical engineering properties, correctly identifying the E6 beam section as W8X13 whereas Set A incorrectly claims W10X15. Set A frequently invents the condition "between GRID 3 and GRID 4" (5 claims) which is not supported by the document, while Set B only does so once.
